Blue($x, bool) ::: Is x blue?
Green($x, bool) ::: Is x green?
Red($x, bool) ::: Is x red?
Sees($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x see y?
Needs($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x need y?
Visits($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x visit y?
Cold($x, bool) ::: Is x cold?
Nice($x, bool) ::: Is x nice?

Blue(Bear, True) ::: The bear is blue.
Green(Bear, True) ::: The bear is green.
Red(Bear, True) ::: The bear is red.
Sees(Bear, Rabbit, True) ::: The bear sees the rabbit.
Blue(Cow, True) ::: The cow is blue.
Needs(Cow, Tiger, True) ::: The cow needs the tiger.
Visits(Cow, Rabbit, True) ::: The cow visits the rabbit.
Cold(Rabbit, True) ::: The rabbit is cold.
Nice(Rabbit, True) ::: The rabbit is nice.
Needs(Rabbit, Cow, True) ::: The rabbit needs the cow.
Sees(Rabbit, Cow, True) ::: The rabbit sees the cow.
Sees(Rabbit, Tiger, True) ::: The rabbit sees the tiger.
Needs(Tiger, Bear, True) ::: The tiger needs the bear.
Needs(Tiger, Rabbit, True) ::: The tiger needs the rabbit.
Visits(Tiger, Bear, True) ::: The tiger visits the bear.
Visits(Tiger, Cow, True) ::: The tiger visits the cow.

Rules:
Green($x, True) >>> Visits($x, Tiger, True) ::: If something is green then it visits the tiger.
Sees($x, Bear, True) && Cold($x, True) >>> Green(Bear, True) ::: If something sees the bear and it is cold then the bear is green.
Needs(Cow, Rabbit, True) && Needs(Rabbit, Cow, True) >>> Red(Rabbit, True) ::: If the cow needs the rabbit and the rabbit needs the cow then the rabbit is red.
Green($x, True) >>> Needs($x, Cow, True) ::: If something is green then it needs the cow.
Visits($x, Tiger, True) >>> Red(Tiger, True) ::: If something visits the tiger then the tiger is red.
Needs($x, Tiger, True) && Sees(Tiger, Cow, True) >>> Needs(Cow, Bear, True) ::: If something needs the tiger and the tiger sees the cow then the cow needs the bear.
Sees($x, Bear, True) && Needs($x, Bear, True) >>> Sees($x, Cow, True) ::: If something sees the bear and it needs the bear then it sees the cow.
Visits($x, Rabbit, True) >>> Needs(Rabbit, Tiger, True) ::: If something visits the rabbit then the rabbit needs the tiger.
Needs($x, Bear, True) && Visits(Bear, Tiger, True) >>> Sees($x, Bear, True) ::: If something needs the bear and the bear visits the tiger then it sees the bear.

Blue(Bear, False) ::: The bear is not blue.
